description: FNPF 2D regular waves of fnpf_2d_regular_rk4 (RK4, sigma cross terms implicit) with A 321 0. fnpf_2d_regular_rk4 runs with the default A 321 2: the start value of the first solve extrapolated to t^n + dt/2 and that of the third to t^n + dt, the second and the fourth start from the solve before them; the coarse levels of REEFMG of the first solve kept for the other three.
